items.text: Most PCM salary pages print a range and move on. The range hides who was counted and when.

items.heading: The Order Below Is Not
items.text: The order below is not prestige order or exam-difficulty order. It leads with the routes where pay can grow beyond a salary scale, then moves to routes where the ladder is fixed. Every route carries one of three labels: Scalable, Scalable with a business layer, or Not so scalable.

items.heading: Growth Is Smaller Than Most
items.text: Growth is smaller than most people hope, and it is easy to measure.

rows: Software and AI-adjacent roles Scalable Software skills sell as products, freelance projects and agencies. It is also the most crowded door, so proof decides the pay.

About Rs 3 to 3.5 lakh at general IT-services starts (TeamLease Digital, Sept 2025). Rs 7 to 21 lakh on named specialist tracks at one large firm (Infosys, reported Dec 2025). Average total pay Rs 5.37 lakh under one year (PayScale, 414 salaries, July 2026).
Average total pay Rs 7.54 lakh at 1 to 4 years (PayScale, 3,685 salaries). No sampled year-five figure found.
The 90th percentile base pay is about Rs 20 lakh across all experience (PayScale, 4,950 profiles). Freelance and product income has no verified spread.
Sampled salary site
Data, analytics and business-tech roles Scalable Analysis and reporting sell directly as projects and consulting, and one skill serves many businesses.
No sampled entry figure we trust. Sources disagree, so start from the software floor above and read live listings.
Not found with a sample.
Not found with a sample. Say less, not more.
No reliable data
Architecture (B.Arch, then registration) Scalable with a business layer A salaried junior is a fixed ladder. A registered practice with your own pricing is the business layer.
Rs 3 to 6 lakh, median about Rs 4.5 lakh (Salaryinsight, April 2026, built from Glassdoor and AmbitionBox, no sample size given).
Not found with a sample.
No verified spread of own-practice income. Treat any single crore-level figure as a famous-firm outlier.
Aggregator, no sample size
Core engineering (mechanical, civil, electrical, electronics) Scalable with a business layer Core jobs follow a fixed ladder. Design, repair, solar or contracting services give the business layer.
Rs 25,000 a month (Rs 3.0 lakh a year) is the formal-work median for all engineering degrees at entry (PLFS 2025, 182 people). We found no branch-wise sampled pay.
Rs 42,000 a month (Rs 5.04 lakh a year) at 3 or more years in the same survey.
42.9% earn Rs 50,000 a month or more at 3 or more years, against 11.2% at entry.
